title: ARIA tabs + a11y fixes across dashboard and account pages
description: Custom button-tab pattern (no role=tablist/tab/tabpanel, no aria-selected, no aria-controls, no arrow-key navigation, no roving tabindex) appears in both src/app/dashboard/components/dashboard-navigation.tsx and src/app/accounts/[name]/_components/tab-navigation.tsx. Both pages drive state via URL params (?section= and ?tab=), so the simpler fix is converting the buttons to <a href> links with aria-current=page inside <nav aria-label>, avoiding the full APG tablist contract while still being keyboard- and AT-correct. Sticky nav also needs scroll-margin-top to stop covering focused content (WCAG 2.4.11 AA). This issue is the umbrella for the broader a11y + WIG audit fixes from session 2026-05-08 covering: ARIA tabs, focus-visible outlines, JS-hover→CSS-hover migration, contrast bumps on active tab text, dialog semantics + Escape on chat panel, sort/pagination aria-labels, fieldset/legend on filter groups, type=search input, error-page h1, hardcoded hex → tokens, gradient overload on metric tiles, tabular-nums on figures, prefers-reduced-motion respect, tab-content lazy rendering keyed by searchParams.
acceptance_criteria: No interactive element relies on JS hover handlers for visual state. Active tab text contrast >= 4.5:1. role=dialog + aria-modal + Escape on chat panel. <a href + aria-current=page on both tabs (dashboard + accounts). Lint/type-check + smoke tests pass.
close_reason: Tabs converted to <a href>+aria-current across both dashboard and account pages; WCAG 2.2 fixes shipped (focus-visible, sticky scroll-margin, dialog semantics + Escape + focus trap, fieldset/legend, type=search, 24x24 targets, contrast, aria-labels). 49/49 smoke + 161/161 unit. Commit 00d0b3c on fix/pr-review-hardening.
